title_en: Opinion of the Supreme People's Court on Providing Judicial Services and Safeguards for the Key Work of Comprehensively Promoting Rural Revitalization in 2022
full_text_en:
Supreme People's Court

Opinions on Providing Judicial Services and Guarantees for Effectively Advancing Key Work of Comprehensively Promoting Rural Revitalization in 2022

Fa [2022] No. 74

To thoroughly implement the important speech delivered by General Secretary Xi Jinping at the meeting of the Standing Committee of the Political Bureau of the CPC Central Committee specially studying the work related to agriculture, rural areas, and farmers (the "three rural" issues), as well as his important instructions on political and legal work; to fully implement the guiding principles of the 19th National Congress of the Communist Party of China and the plenary sessions of the 19th CPC Central Committee; to fully implement the "Opinions of the CPC Central Committee and the State Council on Effectively Advancing Key Work of Comprehensively Promoting Rural Revitalization in 2022"; and to give full play to the trial functions of the People's Courts in order to provide strong judicial services and guarantees for achieving new progress in rural revitalization and new steps in agricultural and rural modernization, the following opinions are put forward.

I. Unify Thinking, Deeply Understand the Significant Importance of Providing Judicial Services and Guarantees for Effectively Advancing Key Work of Comprehensively Promoting Rural Revitalization in 2022

1. Effectively strengthen the sense of mission and responsibility in serving the key work of comprehensively promoting rural revitalization in 2022. Effectively advancing the key work of comprehensively promoting rural revitalization in 2022, continuing to comprehensively promote rural revitalization, and ensuring stable agricultural production and increased output, steady income growth for farmers, and stability and security in rural areas are major decisions and deployments made by the CPC Central Committee with Comrade Xi Jinping at its core. People's courts at all levels must adhere to the guidance of Xi Jinping Thought on Socialism with Chinese Characteristics for a New Era, fully implement the guiding principles of the 19th National Congress of the Communist Party of China and the plenary sessions of the 19th CPC Central Committee, thoroughly implement the guiding principles of the Central Economic Work Conference, effectively unify thoughts and actions with the decisions and deployments of the CPC Central Committee, strengthen the "Four Consciousnesses," firm up the "Four Confidences," achieve the "Two Upholds," deeply study and understand the decisive significance of the "Two Establishments," adhere to the general principle of pursuing progress while ensuring stability, base ourselves on the new development stage, implement the new development philosophy, build a new development pattern, promote high-quality development, promote common prosperity, benchmark against the decisions, deployments, and work requirements of the CPC Central Committee, effectively strengthen the sense of responsibility and mission in providing judicial services for the "three rural" issues, closely combine with the actual work of the People's Courts, highlight annual tasks, targeted measures, and timeliness orientation, carry out work creatively, take concrete and effective measures to serve the key work of rural development, rural construction, and rural governance, and provide strong judicial services and guarantees for achieving new progress in rural revitalization and new steps in agricultural and rural modernization.

II. Focus on Guaranteeing Agricultural and Rural Development Factors, Actively Serve Rural Development

2. Properly adjudicate dispute cases involving new business formats in the "three rural" fields, and continuously promote the integrated development of rural industries. Adjudicate dispute cases involving new business formats such as rural leisure tourism, rural homestays, and leisure agriculture according to law; promote the implementation of the rural leisure tourism improvement plan; support the development of rural homestays and characteristic villages (spots) of farmhouse entertainment; promote the establishment of a modern agricultural industrial system, production system, and management system; and actively serve the revitalization of rural industries. Adjudicate dispute cases involving agricultural product processing, rural e-commerce, etc., according to law; support the rapid development of agricultural product processing in major agricultural counties; promote the standardized and healthy development of agricultural by-product production, processing, and circulation; and boost the integrated development of primary, secondary, and tertiary industries in rural areas.

3. Promote the market-based allocation of land factors and ensure the smooth implementation of rural land system reform. Carefully adjudicate dispute cases involving the market entry of rural collective operational construction land and the mortgage of homestead use rights; in accordance with relevant national policies and opinions, steadily promote the market entry of rural collective operational construction land, the mortgage financing of collective operational construction land use rights, and the reform of the rural homestead system; and promote the implementation of key tasks in rural reform.

4. Support the market-based allocation of labor factors and guide the orderly flow of labor and rural revitalization talents. Adjudicate labor dispute cases involving new forms of employment according to law; properly identify the labor relationship between workers in new forms of employment and platform enterprises and cooperative enterprises; reasonably determine the rights and obligations between enterprises and workers; and strengthen the protection of the rights and interests of workers in new forms of employment. Adjudicate labor and personnel dispute cases involving rural revitalization talents according to law; actively promote the connection between labor dispute arbitration and litigation procedures; promote the improvement of factor transaction rules; and support the construction of a rural revitalization talent team.

5. Strengthen judicial protection of the rural ecological environment and promote the green development of agriculture and rural areas. Practice the concept that lucid waters and lush mountains are invaluable assets; give full play to the trial functions of environmental resources; strengthen civil trial work and supervision and guidance in key areas such as rural ecological environmental protection; and promptly respond to social concerns. Comprehensively apply systems such as environmental protection injunctions and punitive damages; strengthen comprehensive management of agricultural non-point source pollution and ecosystem management of major rivers and lakes; and build a judicial barrier for rural ecological security.

6. Strengthen judicial protection of germplasm resource security and help fight the "turnaround battle" in the seed industry. Implement the Seed Law; strictly protect national germplasm resources according to law; severely crack down on the production and sale of counterfeit and shoddy varieties and seed counterfeiting; enhance the level of judicial protection of seed industry intellectual property rights; and effectively guarantee national seed industry and food security. Strengthen the protection of geographical indications for high-quality agricultural products; ensure the development of regional characteristic economies. Improve the cooperation mechanism for protecting seed industry intellectual property rights; and form a joint force for protection.

7. Unify personal injury compensation standards and promote integrated urban-rural development. In accordance with the requirements of the "Notice of the Supreme People's Court on Further Promoting the Pilot Work of Unifying Urban and Rural Personal Injury Compensation Standards," adjudicate various types of personal injury compensation dispute cases according to law; unify the compensation standards to those for urban residents; and promote the pilot work of unifying compensation standards for urban and rural residents in personal injury compensation dispute cases.

III. Give Full Play to the Guiding Role of Justice, Steadily Advance Rural Construction

8. Adjudicate dispute cases concerning rural infrastructure construction in key areas according to law, and promote the implementation of projects to strengthen weak links and promote development. Increase the intensity of adjudication of dispute cases concerning infrastructure and public service facility construction in key counties for rural revitalization support and centralized resettlement areas for relocation; ensure the effective connection of judicial service measures for consolidating and expanding the achievements of poverty alleviation with those for rural revitalization; and promote the filling of weak links and shortcomings in rural construction. Increase enforcement efforts in cases involving wage arrears in rural infrastructure construction, especially enforcement efforts for arrears of project payments and arrears of migrant workers' wages in poverty alleviation projects; consolidate and expand the effectiveness of efforts to address wage arrears; and ensure that the bottom line of preventing large-scale return to poverty is not crossed.

9. Continuously promote the improvement of the rural living environment and effectively improve the quality of the ecological environment in rural areas. Focusing on the overall goal of fighting the battle against pollution, support rural areas in promoting the treatment of domestic waste, domestic sewage, and black and odorous water bodies; promote the implementation of village cleaning actions and greening and beautification actions; and continuously promote the improvement of the rural living environment. Properly handle dispute cases arising from rural toilet renovation according to law; correctly handle adjacent relations based on the principles of facilitating production, convenience of life, unity and mutual assistance, and fairness and reasonableness, in accordance with laws, regulations, and local customs. Deepen judicial collaboration and coordinated ecological environment governance in rural areas; continuously improve coordination and linkage mechanisms; and actively build a diversified co-governance system for the rural environment.

10. Promote remediation actions such as illegal occupation of farmland for construction and "greenhouse villas," and strictly adhere to the red line of 1.8 billion mu of arable land. Increase the intensity of trial and enforcement work in cases of illegal occupation of farmland; fully implement the food security strategy; strengthen the protection of farmland use; and promote the governance of "non-agriculturalization" and "non-grainization" of farmland according to law. Give comprehensive play to the trial functions of criminal, civil, and administrative laws; promote the special clean-up and remediation of illegal occupation of farmland for construction and "greenhouse villas"; and effectively implement the hard measures for farmland protection with "teeth."

11. Increase the intensity of trial and enforcement work in cases involving people's livelihoods, and continuously promote the consolidation and expansion of poverty alleviation achievements. Adjudicate cases in the field of people's livelihoods such as elderly care and childcare in rural areas according to law; strengthen the protection of the rights and interests of migrant workers and flexible workers. Accelerate the promotion of comprehensive management and source governance of difficulties in enforcing judgments in the field of people's livelihoods; adhere to the principles of priority for case filing, priority for enforcement, and priority for distribution of enforcement funds; fully utilize online and offline property investigation measures to search for property of the person subject to enforcement; make good use of various compulsory measures; crack down on criminal acts of refusing to enforce judgments and rulings in the field of people's livelihoods according to law; and ensure that the successful rights and interests of creditors in people's livelihood cases are realized in a timely manner. Increase judicial assistance efforts; effectively prevent phenomena such as falling into poverty or returning to poverty due to litigation.

IV. Consolidate the Grassroots Foundation of Rural Revitalization, Vigorously Improve the Quality and Effectiveness of Rural Governance

12. Continuously promote the normalization of the crackdown on organized crime and local tyrants in rural areas, ensuring rural stability and security. Effectively implement the holistic approach to national security; normalize the fight against organized crime and local tyrants; focus on "case resolution," "thorough cleaning of ill-gotten gains," "smashing protective umbrellas and breaking networks," and "comprehensive governance"; and improve long-term mechanisms. Severely crack down on criminal acts such as interfering, manipulating, or destroying elections using clan or family forces; actively prevent the erosion of rural grassroots political power by clan forces, organized crime, and evil forces.

13. Severely crack down on pornography, gambling, and drug-related crimes in rural areas and illegal and criminal acts infringing upon the legitimate rights and interests of groups such as rural women and children, effectively maintaining rural social harmony and stability. Punish pornography, gambling, and drug-related illegal and criminal acts in rural areas according to law; eradicate the breeding ground for such illegal and criminal acts; and promote the construction of spiritual civilization in rural areas. Severely crack down on illegal and criminal acts such as infringing upon the personal rights of rural women and children according to law; protect the personal rights of groups such as rural women and children according to law. Strengthen judicial protection of minors; implement the Family Education Promotion Law; and strengthen the protection of the legitimate rights and interests of minors. When adjudicating cases involving disputes over the membership qualifications of collective economic organization members such as rural women and children, pay attention to protecting the legitimate rights and interests of groups such as rural women and children according to law. For acts infringing upon the legitimate rights and interests of groups such as rural women and children, increase the intensity of ex officio investigation and evidence collection; promptly issue personal safety protection orders; and protect the legitimate rights and interests of groups such as rural women and children according to law.

14. Protect agricultural and rural historical and cultural heritage according to law, and promote the revitalization of rural culture. Adjudicate cases involving agricultural and rural historical and cultural heritage according to law; promote the implementation of the agricultural cultural heritage protection project; enhance the awareness of protection and inheritance among residents of heritage sites and traditional villages through judicial means; and promote the inheritance and development of excellent Chinese culture. Adjudicate cases involving new business formats in agricultural cultural tourism according to law; promote the development of new business formats in agricultural cultural tourism such as farming experiences and popular science education; promote cultural inheritance and employment income increase; and continuously enhance the sense of gain, happiness, and satisfaction of farmers in the protection, inheritance, and utilization of agricultural cultural heritage.

15. Regulate high bride prices in rural areas according to law, and promote the rectification of prominent issues in key areas of changing outdated customs in rural areas. Adjudicate dispute cases involving high bride prices in rural areas according to law; distinguish bride prices from general gifts based on factors such as customs, the amount of bride price, the purpose of payment, and the time of payment; comprehensively consider factors such as the payer's economic resources, income level, local economic income, and customs when adjudicating bride price dispute cases; guide the broad masses of farmers to establish correct concepts of marriage; abandon the trend of bride price comparison; and allow wedding customs to return to their original intentions and marriage to return to its essence.

16. Give full play to the achievements of one-stop construction, and continuously improve the effectiveness of dispute resolution. Focus on the integrated role of one-stop construction; closely focus on one-stop, intensive, integrated, online, and convergent; accelerate the extension of one-stop construction to key industries and fields of the "three rural" issues; remove bottlenecks hindering joint contribution, shared governance, and shared benefits; improve the work pattern of source prevention and resolution of conflicts and disputes; efficiently, conveniently, and diversely resolve "three rural" disputes; and enhance the sense of gain of farmers.

17. Build "Fengqiao-style People's Courts," and promote the construction of higher-level peaceful and law-based rural villages. Adhere to the orientation of strengthening grassroots foundations; conscientiously implement the principles of "three convenience" and "three services"; improve the construction of People's Courts in the new era; and promote new improvements in the construction of People's Courts. Adhere to and develop the "Fengqiao Experience" in the new era; create a batch of "Fengqiao-style People's Courts"; strive to expand new ways for People's Courts to serve grassroots governance; and better serve rural governance. Strengthen the construction and application of the "two platforms" of the People's Court work platform and information platform; improve guarantees in infrastructure, business equipment, and funding; and promote the modernization of the grassroots governance system and governance capacity.

V. Innovate Working Mechanisms, Comprehensively Improve the Comprehensive Effectiveness of Serving the "Three Rural" Issues

18. Improve coordination and linkage mechanisms, forming an overall joint force for promoting rural revitalization. Actively integrate into the grassroots governance system led by the Party committee; strengthen connections and coordination with township and sub-district offices and comprehensive governance centers; timely grasp, analyze, and assess the situation of conflicts and disputes; and provide references for the scientific decision-making of the Party committee and government. Strengthen connections with relevant government departments; promptly report contradictions and problems in the "three rural" fields; fully mobilize the enthusiasm of all departments; and form an overall joint force for comprehensively promoting rural revitalization.

19. Deepen the reform of the litigation system, and promote the convenient and efficient resolution of "three rural" disputes. Conscientiously implement the decision of the Standing Committee of the National People's Congress on amending the "Civil Procedure Law of the People's Republic of China"; focus on the identification of simple and complex cases, the application of procedural diversion, the coordinated allocation of resources, and the diversified resolution of conflicts; improve supporting mechanisms and measures; effectively enhance the trial efficiency and case quality of "three rural" dispute cases; and enhance the judicial sense of gain of farmers.

20. Strengthen the construction of smart courts, and create a higher level of digital justice. Adhere to technology-driven approaches; promote the judicial application of emerging technologies such as 5G, blockchain, and artificial intelligence; improve various platform systems; effectively solve problems such as platform dispersion and data silos; and provide intelligent, integrated, and collaborative smart services for the litigation of farmers. Deepen innovation in online litigation models and rules; reasonably and accurately use online trial mechanisms based on factors such as the nature and characteristics of "three rural" dispute cases; and ensure that online litigation "reduces costs without reducing quality and improves efficiency without reducing rights." Make full use of the advantages of judicial big data; strengthen the assessment and resolution of conflicts and disputes in key cases in related fields; improve governance rules; and promote the modernization of the digital economy governance system and governance capacity.

March 1, 2022
